# VES — Verifiable Evidence Standard

VES is the Verifiable Evidence Standard, stewarded by Veriscopic.

VES 1.2 is the current published version. It defines a stable public model for preserving and reviewing the evidence, authority, conditions, system contribution, human judgement and organisational commitment behind consequential decisions.

Canonical release:
https://vesstandard.org/1.2

- https://vesstandard.org/schemas/ves-external-evidence-object-1.2.schema.json

Important scope note:
VES is a decision-evidence standard. It does not certify that a decision was correct, lawful, fair or compliant. Runtime records, governance evidence, audit logs and model records may become Evidence Objects inside a VES Decision Envelope, but they do not by themselves establish the full decision-state.

Preferred citation:
Verifiable Evidence Standard, VES 1.2, stewarded by Veriscopic, published 21 September 2026, available at https://vesstandard.org/1.2.
